steps.title: Start with Call 1
steps.body: Score Call 1 as Pass or Fail and capture coaching/fail reasons.
steps.tip: Use Other only when no predefined reason applies.

steps.title: Complete Call 2
steps.body: Repeat scoring and notes for Call 2 before moving on.
steps.tip: Ensure required fields are complete before continuing.

steps.title: Understand Call 3 rule
steps.body: Call 3 is hidden when Call 1 and Call 2 both pass.
steps.tip: If either call fails, Call 3 remains required.

steps.title: Record attempt outcome
steps.body: Set each attempt to Pass, Fail, or Not Attempted.
steps.tip: At least two attempts are tracked in the workflow.

steps.title: Capture follow-up details
steps.body: When a failed transfer requires follow-up, set the follow-up flag and date.
steps.tip: A missing follow-up date creates a validation error.

steps.title: Generate both summaries
steps.body: Create coaching and fail summaries before attempting submit.
steps.tip: Retry summaries if one fails to generate.

steps.title: Resolve blocking warnings
steps.body: Fix any Error-severity warnings in Calls or Transfer tabs.
steps.tip: Warnings with severity Error block submission readiness.

steps.title: Submit explicitly
steps.body: Review only submits when you press Submit Review.
steps.tip: Submission is manual and does not happen automatically.
